name: css-battle-toolbox
author: Evan Liomain
description: Some usefull tools for Css Battle

scripts.copy-assets: cp src/options.js dist/src && cp -R images dist
scripts.build: tsc && vite build && npm run copy-assets && zip -r css-battle-toolbox.zip dist
scripts.watch: tsc && vite build && npm run copy-assets && vite build --watch --emptyOutDir false
